svg.aria-label: Nine unitary spectral distribution classes with centered eigenphase hairlines and Poisson smoothed contour
svg.text: Spectral distributions on the unit circle
Centered hairlines · extended polar grid · Poisson smoothing r = 0.94
D, H, I: hairlines are illustrative quantiles, not finite CMV eigenvalues. All contours are Poisson-smoothed reference measures.
